query: My deployment is taking 18 minutes — make it faster
expected_behavior: Identifies the dominant phase (build / startup / health-check / scheduling / image pull)
Classifies the bottleneck per reference/phase2-classify.md (user-controllable vs Qovery infrastructure)
If user-controllable: loads reference/phase3-diagnose.md and proposes Dockerfile / health-check / stage-parallelism fixes
If infra-side: loads reference/diagnostic-report-template.md and prepares a Qovery-support escalation report

query: My Docker build is slow — npm ci runs every time even when no deps change
expected_behavior: Identifies that the Dockerfile copies the whole project before npm ci, invalidating the layer cache
Proposes the canonical pattern: COPY package*.json / RUN npm ci / COPY .
Suggests adding a .dockerignore to exclude node_modules and dist from the build context
Estimates the improvement (typically 30-60% on subsequent builds)

query: Health check times out on every deploy — initial_delay_seconds=30 isn't enough for my Java app
expected_behavior: Confirms the failure pattern via the V2 deployment logs
Recommends increasing initial_delay_seconds (and possibly using a startup probe instead of a liveness probe for slow JVM apps)
Applies the change via PUT /application/{appId} and triggers a redeploy
Re-measures via deploymentHistoryV2 to confirm the deployment now succeeds within the new window
